dataset.citation: Cortez et al. (2009). Wine Quality. https://doi.org/10.24432/C56S3T
dataset.original_units: Values as supplied in the source data file

aggregation.timing_and_memory: Median [min, max] across 3 seeds x 3 repeats = 9 workers per variant.
aggregation.quality: Repeat 1 for each of 3 seeds after exact repeat quality/hash/imputed-value checks.
aggregation.total_seconds: Consecutive fit plus first held-out transform; no additional transforms.
aggregation.speedup: Median [min, max] of 9 matched numerator/denominator timing ratios; not ratio of medians.
aggregation.additional_matching: Same archived run, prepared case/fingerprints, validated model parameters and native thread settings.
aggregation.duration_change: Median [min, max] of 100 * (denominator/numerator time - 1) for matched records.
aggregation.output_agreement: Recompute hidden-entry differences from saved imputed_values; compare recorded full-output hashes.
aggregation.quality_evidence: Aggregate stored worker errors against held-out truth; underlying truth/mask arrays are not regenerated.
aggregation.memory: Peak sampled after validation and before worker JSON serialization; includes setup and warmup, not isolated transform memory.
aggregation.numeric_precision: Unrounded binary64 calculations from parsed JSON, serialized at round-trip precision; Markdown alone is rounded.
